title: Newspaper Start-Up
bottom_line: The quantitative analysis reveals the plan is infeasible: with homes averaging 10 meters apart, each square kilometer contains 10,000 stops. With only 7,200 seconds available (2 hours), carriers would need to deliver more than one newspaper per second—a practical impossibility. Two alternatives are proposed: reducing the distribution area to focus on profitable subscribers, or changing the distribution method through co-distribution partnerships or alternative channels.
